result:
My verdict for DG4 round 9 (task T-DG4-REV-DOM-R9) is **PASS**, with **no new findings**. All nine findings I had closed before re-verify and go back to CLOSED_VERIFIED.

**Candidate.** The candidate ID recomputes to `sha256:18c18fe4…ddad76c` (1,475 files) on a complete clone, both at the source commit `f2ae717` and at the freeze commit `01ad2e1`. It matches the manifest. HEAD is `01ad2e1`, which adds only the round-9 assignments, the manifest and `stages.json` on top of the source commit.

**Confirmation checks** (all PASS):
- **The diff from `5cd1e06` is records only.** It has no changes outside `docs/delivery/**`. Round 8's and round 9's manifests differ only in `decisions.md` (D-135 and D-136), and the requirements register and migrations are unchanged.
- **History rewrite.** Diffing the backup ref against `a445b24` shows exactly 33 files, all additions under `docs/delivery/runs/DG4`, and they match the restored-paths list blob for blob. I checked all 360 pairs in the SHA map, not just a sample. Every pair has the same subject, author and committer, and its trees differ only in restored run files. Five pairs were also inspected one by one. The rewrite starts after the DG3 gate commit `bc8f455`, so DG0–DG3 are untouched.
- **D-136.** It matches the evidence on all four defects:
  - B1: `decisions.md` is inside the frozen candidate;
  - B2: 23 findings are pending re-verification, each with a full `fix_revision`;
  - B3: the 33 restored run files are back in the history;
  - B4: every round's `frozen_at` equals its manifest.

  It changes no product or G1–G6 behaviour. One thing I accept rather than flag: the old manifests and `stages.json` still name the pre-rewrite commit ids. D-136 discloses this and the SHA map links them.
- **Validators.** `--historical` for DG3, DG2 and DG1, `--register DG4` and `--pipeline` all pass with exit 0, in the clone and in the working tree.
- **Static checks.** Typecheck, lint, the Prettier check, `openapi:lint` (652 operations) and no-cdn all exit 0. The playbook's forum cadence (B0093) and Monthly Health Check (B0095) tables appear verbatim in their seed migrations, with nothing missing. The product-hygiene checks are unchanged:
  - no claim of PMI certification or official status;
  - `#0078FF` appears only as a provisional token;
  - the wordmark and the Arabic labels are marked provisional.

**Findings re-verified** (all PASS → CLOSED_VERIFIED):

| Finding | Severity |
|---|---|
| F-DG4-120 | Low |
| F-DG4-121 | Medium |
| F-DG4-122 | High, mandatory |
| F-DG4-123 | Medium |
| F-DG4-124 | Medium |
| F-DG4-125 | High, mandatory |
| F-DG4-126 | Medium |
| F-DG4-127 | Medium |
| F-DG4-128 | Medium |

For each one, the `fix_revision` and every listed fix commit are ancestors of `f2ae717`. Each maps to an old commit on the backup ref, and the old and new commits change the product identically. The fix is still in the frozen code, cited by file and line. The targeted unit tests passed: 91/91 in `unit-node` and 125/125 in `unit-web`, run with `--configLoader runner` because `node_modules` is read-only.

**Disclosed, not defects:**
- The `unit-web` log has 14 React duplicate-key warnings. They come from test fixtures that reuse one KPI id, are the same warnings disclosed in rounds 4–7, and fail no test.
- The logs have advisory `npm warn Unknown project config` lines.
- The validator run took over 10 minutes under the shared load and was moved to the background, then finished with exit 0.

**Carried forward, not re-run:** the real-stack API probes, the English and Arabic UI screenshots, the KPI and value-semantics probes, the integration and build runs, and my judgement of the two QA observations. The load envelope forbids a real stack, the integration suite and e2e for me this round. Each of these checks says so in its record and cites my round-7 evidence on byte-identical code. That includes the worker integration test for F-DG4-128.

The three environmental residuals (live registry, live CI, Keycloak) are recorded as PASS on the offline surface. No business, Finance or G1–G6 approval is implied, and nothing here relates to DG7. The disposable clone has been removed.

Files are in `docs/delivery/`:
- `reviews/DG4/round-9/domain-reviewer.json`
- `reviews/DG4/round-9/domain-reviewer.verifications.json`
- `test-evidence/DG4/domain/round-9/` (scripts and logs)
